exactGap: No agent tool-request executor on a user machine exists: nothing opens an outbound SSE or polling channel to receive Model-proposed tool requests, and there is no Control-signed grant or receipt protocol for local execution. The cloud-first path the item asks for is largely there: gateway browser routes give live frames, agent_control/human_takeover and persistent profiles, and sandbox-manager has leases, a durable workspace manifest, snapshots and a process registry.

approachAdjustment: Fix the plane owner to Application Plane (call presence and caption fan-out) plus Model Plane (ASR, translation, TTS inference), not Model Plane alone. Streaming ASR needs a new inference RPC and provider, and a TTS track needs a media plane that does not exist.
effortNote: M only counts the increment over the call stack and live ASR; streaming ASR with per-speaker captions, fan-out, translation and a published TTS track is L, and XL if the call infrastructure is included.
verdictReason: Confirmed absent and blocked behind three unbuilt prerequisites (calls, live ASR, agent participants); it is a late differentiator that should be shown as a dependent long-tail item, not as a standalone M.

constraints: A snapshot copies content out of the Space's authority into a new audience (org or link), so it needs a new Control decision class (creator authority, audience, purpose, retention, ZDR) and never widens an owner-plane ACL; every plane holding the copy must join the Space deletion and GDPR erase fan-out. ZDR: refuse creation for ZDR orgs and ZDR Spaces. A session-less link route sits outside the gateway's require_session layer and is a new unauthenticated surface, which the plan's external-guest rules (S5.3) do not yet cover. Per the S5.4 ownership line, share metadata belongs to Application Plane and human grants to Control, so Model Plane Session Core is only the source of the projection. File copies need Space attachments, which do not exist.
approachAdjustment: Change the plane owner: Application Plane owns the snapshot record (token hash, creator, scope, expiry, revocation, frozen allowlisted entries) with a Control decision for the audience; Session Core only produces the allowlisted projection at creation (user turns and final assistant text, never reasoning, tool output or raw payloads). Ship org scope first (authenticated members, no new unauthenticated surface) and defer link scope until external-guest rules exist; text only until Space attachments exist. Add the missing noindex and no-store headers on the session-less route rather than relying on the robots.txt comment.
effortNote: M undercounts: a Control decision class, an Application snapshot store, the deletion and erase fan-out, a hardened session-less route and the creator re-check on every view.
verdictReason: Confirmed absent and genuinely unique to QM, but the item puts the share object in Model Plane Session Core against the plan's own S5.4 ownership split, understates the effort, and starts with link scope, the riskiest variant.

constraints: The ticket and Inbox owner is Application Plane (conversation-core-go, gateway tickets.rs and inbox.rs); Support Plane owns no tickets or users, so the item's Support Plane ticket intake is the wrong target. The current feedback lands in the customer org's own Inbox and is mirrored to the vendor team's org, so where an ids-only report goes (customer desk or vendor) is a tenant-boundary decision to make explicitly. ZDR: the existing path persists free text and email regardless of ZDR, so ids plus codes should be the default and free text, screenshots or content require consent and a posture gate. approachAdjustment: Do not build a new Support Plane route. Extend the existing FeedbackWidget and SubmitFeedback with an optional structured diagnostics object (space ref, thread and run ids, request id, error code, client error class, build id from /version) and add entry points on the error card, run console and Space page. Gateway: add a request-id layer and an additive requestId in the error body. Registry: add domain and retryable to the catalogue entries (reuse run.error retryable semantics and the ZDR catalogue's action hint), and add a coverage check that compares gateway error-code literals with errors.ts keys, as a source-scan test since codes are static strings.
effortNote: Unchanged: the report extension is S, request id plus catalogue fields plus the coverage test is M; no new backend route is needed.
verdictReason: A report-friction flow already exists and the ticket intake already exists in Application Plane, so the item should extend them with ids-only diagnostics rather than add a dialog and a Support Plane route; the error-registry half is correctly missing.
